measurements.directive: meas tran vin_peak MAX v(in) FROM=0u TO=400u
meas tran vout_100u FIND v(out) AT=100u
measurements.description: Step response near one time constant

measurements.directive: meas tran rise_time_10_90 TRIG v(out) VAL=0.5 RISE=1 TARG v(out) VAL=4.5 RISE=1
measurements.description: Output rise time from 10 to 90 percent of the 5 V step

measurements.directive: meas tran vout_peak MAX v(out) FROM=0u TO=400u
measurements.description: Peak output voltage must remain below supply
